chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, created the essence of the believer from the essence of the Prophets, so it will never become wicked.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual essence of a believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the ontological purity of the believer by stating that Allah created the believer's spiritual essence (ṭīna) from the same essence as the Prophets, guaranteeing its immunity from ultimate corruption. This hadith, found in *Kitab al-Mumin*, underscores the Shia concept of innate spiritual nobility (fiṭra) shared with the Ahl al-Bayt and the Prophets, distinguishing the true believer's core nature from transient worldly flaws.
